# 00000003924

**FL-14 ★** — source: 116_辛拓扑II_Floer同调.md

**English.** Definition: Split generation means that a category is generated by iterated cone extensions. Conjecture: The split-generation obstruction class of the Fukaya category is exactly the kernel of the closed-open map, and when the closed-open map is surjective the obstruction vanishes automatically. (splitting obstruction and closed-open kernel)

**中文。** 定义：分裂生成指范畴由 cone 反复扩张生成。猜想：Fukaya 范畴的分裂生成障碍类恰为闭开映射的核;当闭开映射满射时障碍自动消没。（分裂障碍-闭开核）
